title: Learn-then-escalate chronological run from first dodge to top speed

clips.why: Clear first action showing swipe-to-dodge and coin collection
Introduces jumping over full-width orange barriers
Rapid lane switching through denser pink X blocks
Crash triggers the free Revive save to continue the run
Speed escalates toward SPD 79 with tighter obstacles and magnet power-up
Peak intensity at SPD 81-85 with tight dodges and consecutive barrier jumps
Closes on the Neon Lanes end card with PLAY NOW CTA
